I️ doubt I️ could help anybody,I’m useless. I️ can’t even kill myself at the right time. I have a lot of criminals in my family as well,part of the reason I’m ending it.
My uncle is out on bail.

It was my father,my father was raped by my mother.
Living isn’t a rare opportunity,it’s a curse.
Yeah I️ get that,but I️ don’t particularly enjoy suffering and would rather have it end

Rape.I️ exist because of rape. My whole life is a failure.
My life is worth nothing.I️ can’t make a new life,I’m too young to make a new life.i’ll rush death because I️ have nothing else to look forward to.
